title: Backend Developer
description: Build and maintain backend services in Java and Spring Boot. Design REST APIs, work with SQL and MongoDB databases and deploy services with Docker on AWS.
responsibilities: Design database schemas and write efficient queries.
Deploy and monitor services in the cloud.
requirements: B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or a related field.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Work across the stack on a SaaS product using React, Node.js and MongoDB. Ship features end to end with a small team.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Create accessible, responsive user interfaces with React and TypeScript, working closely with designers.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Own CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. Run containerised workloads on Kubernetes and automate everything with Terraform.
requirements: B.Tech in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

title: AI Engineer
description: Train, evaluate and deploy machine learning and deep learning models in Python, including NLP and LLM features.
requirements: B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, AI or a related field.

title: Java Developer Intern
description: Learn backend development in Java with a mentor, working on Spring Boot services and SQL databases.
requirements: Pursuing or completed a B.Tech/B.E. degree in Computer Science.
